de3edfbfb76fc3b56a2702aedde9911b04eb6464.sourceText: 启用限制且使用排序时，地面估计不会高于“邻域最低高度 + `maxGroundLift`”。它限制的是分位地面相对最低样本的抬升，不是云台升降、底盘离地高度或每帧地面变化率。
de3edfbfb76fc3b56a2702aedde9911b04eb6464.translatedText: With clamping enabled and sorting in use, the ground estimate will not be higher than "the lowest height in the neighborhood \+ `maxGroundLift`"\. It limits the elevation of the percentile ground relative to the lowest sample, not gimbal elevation, chassis ground clearance, or the per\-frame ground change rate\.
